name: La Piñata Taqueria
tagline: The yellow taco truck on Broadway that made the San Francisco Chronicle's Top Burritos in the Bay Area list. Crunchy suadero, two great salsas, big super burritos.
seoTitle: La Piñata Taqueria | Taco Truck & Burritos in Vallejo, CA
description: La Piñata Taqueria, a taco truck at 809 Broadway, Vallejo, CA. Super burritos, tacos, nachos, quesadillas and tortas. Rated 4.7 on Google. Open Mon–Fri 11am–9pm. (707) 334-8381.

about.title: Fresh ingredients. Big flavor. Fair prices.
body: La Piñata is a yellow lonchera parked at 809 Broadway, serving authentic Mexican food made with fresh, quality ingredients: tacos, tortas, quesadillas, nachos, super burritos and shrimp dishes, plus horchata and agua de jamaica.
In November 2022 the San Francisco Chronicle put La Piñata on its list of Top Burritos in the Bay Area. Some customers drive in from San Francisco for it.

reviews.text: A Suadero Super Burrito from La Piñata might be one of the best things to eat in Vallejo — it’s in the top five at least.
reviews.author: San Francisco Chronicle
reviews.source: Top Burritos in the Bay Area, Nov 2022

reviews.text: La Piñata is so good. I come from San Francisco for it and always get it when I’m in the area. The owner and staff have amazing customer service and the food is always good and fresh.
reviews.author: Google review

reviews.text: This is by far the best burrito place in Vallejo hands down. In every bite of my steak and shrimp burrito you can taste the freshness of all the ingredients.
reviews.author: Google review

reviews.text: suadero super burrito 10/10 would recommend. best burrito i’ve had in a minute!
reviews.author: Google review

reviews.text: I got their lengua, cabeza and carnitas tacos. The most was so tender and flavorful.
reviews.author: Google review

hoursNote: Closed weekends. Cards accepted (a reviewer notes an extra card charge). Catering available, so call to ask.
